Chapter 566: Chapter 14 Excited Baron Longshan (Please Subscribe)

“Demigod…”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged on the bed.

In this world, those at the Seventh Rank were also known as demigods.

In the Main World, Seventh Rank Evolvers who wished to step into the Eighth Layer needed to open an Inner World.

But here, the strong at the Seventh Rank needed to uphold a Divine Kingdom to enter the realm of the divine.

The latter, in raising a Divine Kingdom, had to rely on the massive power of faith, which is why those demigods risked being discovered by the Prime God to secretly spread their faith in the Plateau of Myriad Nations.

...

Without sufficient faith, they could not become immortal divine spirits, and their physical bodies and souls would quickly decay.

Of course, many Seventh Rank demigods pledged allegiance to a certain Prime God and became subordinate divine spirits.

But the majority of Seventh Rank demigods were very principled. Once they fell into being subordinate divine spirits of a Prime God, everything, including their consciousness, belonged to the Prime God.

Many demigods had steadily grown from weak to strong and naturally were not willing to pay such a price.

“What should I do now…”

Lin Yuan analyzed calmly.

Being targeted by a church founded by a demigod was troublesome.

As for reporting directly to the empire or the “Church of Light”? It would indeed be effective, but there was no guarantee that the demigod would be killed.

If he survived, he might seek revenge later, and Longshan Ling could not currently withstand the slaughter of a demigod-level strong person.

The strongest in Longshan Ling was the First Viscount of Longshan, a Fifth Level Great Knight… enough to traverse the empire, but far too weak compared to a Seventh Rank demigod.

“Return directly to Longshan Ling…” Lin Yuan contemplated for a moment and made a decision in his mind.

Although Anpu City was prosperous, it was a mix of dragons and snakes; even a demigod church had emerged. Before possessing absolute power, Lin Yuan did not even want to touch such a place.

Longshan Ling, however, was his family’s territory, officially ordained by the empire. There, the demigod church, hated by everyone on the Plateau of Myriad Nations, dared not show itself openly.

“Dashan.”

Lin Yuan walked out of the room, sunlight warmly hitting him, and murmured softly.

“Young Master.” A burly man over three meters tall strode forward.

“What can I do for you, Young Master?” The burly man ‘Dashan’ spoke with a booming voice, his words carrying a resonant and heavy breath.

“I’m going back to Longshan Ling.”

Lin Yuan looked at the towering figure in front of him.

Dashan was Lin Yuan’s guard; even among the entirety of Longshan Ling, Dashan’s strength was ranked in the top twenty, his body coursing with Sub-Dragon blood.

Though he was only of Fourth Level strength, when fully unleashing his activated bloodline, he could even hold his own against a Fourth Level Knight for half an hour.

The only drawback was his lack of intelligence, but from the perspective of a guard, as long as the martial prowess was sufficient, that was all that mattered.

“Returning to Longshan Ling?”

Dashan was momentarily stunned as previously when the Young Master came to Anpu City, he would play for three or four months; why was he leaving after just one month?

“Young Master, was it because that girl last night didn’t serve you well?” Dashan muttered: “I knew that girl was no good, all skinny like a twig.”

“Young Master, when you have the time, I’ll introduce you to a few that are really sturdy, they’ll definitely serve you comfortably…”

Dashan immediately said, as in his aesthetic, women naturally were better the more robust they were, ideally over three meters tall and with a waist over one meter.

Only then could they ignite his desire for conquest.

Poor Young Master Longshan, always indulging in those twig-like, thin girls, completely unaware of the taste of strong women… Dashan felt deep sympathy for Longshan Yuan.

“Grandfather told me to rush back.”

Lin Yuan made up an excuse, not mentioning too much about the fox-woman.

Dashan wasn’t the sharpest, and anything he learned might get out, which could alert the others if the fox-woman really was involved with a certain demigod’s church.

Now, Lin Yuan just wanted to quietly return to Longshan Ling and steady himself by slowly cultivating; time was on his side.

Once Lin Yuan regained his full strength, not just some mere demigod church, even the divine beings from the Ocean of Light and the Abyss of Darkness would hold no fear for him.

“Viscount, sir…” Dashan’s expression also grew serious.

In all of Longshan Ling, there were few he respected, and the Viscount of Longshan was definitely one of them.

“Then let’s leave now.” Dashan immediately said.

“Alright.” Lin Yuan nodded as well.

Such situations had occurred before when Longshan Yuan was having fun, he would suddenly receive orders from Longshan Ling, forcing him to return midway.

Now, using the orders of the Viscount of Longshan as a reason, leaving Anpu City to return to Longshan Ling was nothing but normal and reasonable.

Lin Yuan led his guards out of Anpu City.

The deputy mayor of Anpu City personally saw him off, “Young Master Longshan, leaving so urgently, has Anpu City not treated you well?”

The deputy mayor of Anpu City, slightly balding, squinted at Lin Yuan and asked.

“Family matters.” Lin Yuan did not elaborate much, with an impatient look on his face, quite consistent with the usual behavior of Young Master Longshan Yuan.

“Since it’s a matter for the Longshan Family, then take care, Young Master Longshan. Next time you come, Anpu City has prepared a special gift for you…”

The tone of the deputy mayor of Anpu City was kind, although he looked down on the prodigal son-like Longshan Yuan, he had to face the backing of Longshan Ling.

Anpu City, being a point of convergence for several Viscount territories, needed to please those few Viscount families to thrive.

With a rumbling sound,

under the watchful eyes of the deputy mayor of Anpu City, Lin Yuan sat in the carriage, surrounded by seven or eight guards, rushing towards Longshan Ling at high speed.
